scope: Theme Studio layout/code editor, member management owner transfer, and custom-domain routing reconciliation; preserves v311 onboarding and v310 Posts/Pages/sidebar authority.
notes: All 100 built-in themes now use the detailed source-owned theme layout composer for published/preview markup.
The layout editor shows two clickable models and all 26 real widget areas, including four left and four right positions around Post/Page content.
The code editor has source line numbers 1-10000, 50:50 code/preview on large screens, and preview above code on compact screens.
Member Owner transfer uses a dedicated database transaction; it is not simulated by changing a label.
Pending custom domains are automatically refreshed so the existing Full Zone provider can attach Worker routing when DNS becomes active.
This release does not claim universal device perfection or extreme login capacity without measured production/device tests.
